name: Morten Engelund
quote:
I worked with Claus and Jasmine at a time when I had recently taken over a leadership team of leaders. There was a clear need to reset how the team worked together and how we showed up toward the broader organisation. As part of this process, I had to say goodbye to some individuals in the leadership team, which created a difficult and uncertain atmosphere among those who remained.

In a 14 months process, Claus and Jasmine helped us reset our collaboration and gradually rebuild trust within the team. They supported us in creating a more solid foundation for how we work together as a leadership group.

What stood out was their ability to introduce simple yet highly effective tools that quickly became part of our shared leadership vocabulary. Several of these tools have since been introduced more broadly in the organisation, creating transparency around how we work as a leadership team.
